Figure 6.Clinician-review prototype (live model outputs). (a) Case overview on 3D rib anatomy, with
model-localized, candidate, and rib-level-only findings shown as distinct states. (b) Per-finding review: the AP
and lateral viewers with markers beside the 3D anatomy and the committed (localized) 3D point. Detection and
addressing remain primary; 3D localization is additive and abstains without dropping a detection.
